title: Implement 'Edit' option in confirmation prompt
description: When user selects 'Edit' in the FeatureDiffPreview, write the spec to a temp file and open it in $EDITOR. After the editor exits, re-read and re-parse the updated content, then re-render the preview.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting 'Edit' opens $EDITOR (or 'vi' as fallback) with spec content
Saving and exiting editor updates the preview with edited content
If user exits editor without changes, preview remains unchanged
Re-rendered preview shows the edited spec before applying

steps.description: Write spec to temp file on Edit selection
steps.details: In the onEdit callback: import { tmpfile } from 'os' (or use path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'rocket-spec.json')). Write the spec content. Open in editor: execSync(`${process.env.EDITOR || 'vi'} ${tmpFile}`, { stdio: 'inherit' })

steps.description: Read edited content and update preview state
steps.details: After execSync returns: const edited = await fs.readFile(tmpFile, 'utf-8'). Parse the edited JSON. If parsing fails, show an error and keep the preview open. If successful, update the spec/tasks state and re-render the preview.
After applying or canceling, delete the temp file: await fs.remove(tmpFile)

technicalNotes: execSync with stdio: 'inherit' allows the editor to take over the terminal and return control when done
This must temporarily unmount or pause the Ink TUI while the editor is open
